starting_position.description: Standard starting position with equal material and no tactics.

hanging_knight.description: White is up a Queen vs Knight (+6) and Black's knight on e5 is hanging.

pinned_knight.description: Black's knight on e5 is pinned to the e8 king by White's rook on e1.

pawn_structure.description: White has doubled pawns on the c-file and isolated pawns; Black has a passed e4 pawn.

exposed_king.description: White's king on g1 is missing its f2 shield pawn and Black's queen on h3 attacks the king ring.

back_rank_weakness_white.description: White's king on g1 is trapped behind f2, g2, h2 pawns with a Black rook on the board.

back_rank_luft_safe.description: White created luft with h3 so the back rank is no longer weak.

rook_skewer_king_queen.description: Wait: Black's king on e8 is behind queen on e5; swap for true skewer: Black king on e5 skewered to queen on e8.

true_rook_skewer.description: White's rook on e1 skewers Black's king on e5 to the Black queen on e8.

bishop_skewer_queen_rook.description: White's bishop on c4 skewers Black's queen on e6 against the rook on f7.

discovered_check_battery.description: White's knight on e5 masks the e1 rook aimed at Black's king on e8 (discovered check threat).

discovered_attack_queen.description: White's bishop on e5 masks the e1 rook aimed at Black's queen on e7.

overloaded_queen_defender.description: Black's queen on e5 is overloaded defending both the c5 knight and g5 rook against White's rooks.

rook_open_file_and_seventh.description: White's rook on d7 dominates the open d-file and sits on the 7th rank.

rook_semi_open_file.description: White's rook on d1 pressures Black's pawn on the semi-open d-file.

pawn_attacking_queen.description: White's pawn on e4 attacks Black's queen on d5 (attacked by lesser piece).

hanging_rook_center.description: Black's rook on d5 is undefended and attacked by White's bishop on b3.

white_passed_pawn_endgame.description: White has a decisive passed pawn on d5.

isolated_queens_pawn.description: Classic IQP structure where White's d4 pawn is isolated.

black_doubled_f_pawns.description: Black has doubled pawns on the f-file.

knight_fork_opportunity.description: White has Nc6 or Nb5/Nf5 setups; sharp tactical position with Black's king and rook on the 8th.

back_rank_mate_threat_black.description: Black's king on g8 is boxed in by f7/g7/h7 pawns with White's rook on d1 threatening Rd8#.

castling_rights_intact.description: Italian Game position where both sides still have kingside castling rights and center control.

black_rook_second_rank.description: Black's rook on b2 invades White's 2nd rank (Black's 7th rank) on an open b-file.
